description: This source file defines the JsonExceptionBuilder interface, a generic builder pattern for constructing JsonException instances with mutable properties such as message, description, cause, and href. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically within the JSON package, facilitating the creation of detailed and informative JSON-related exception objects.

classes.name: JsonExceptionBuilder
classes.description: A generic mutable builder interface for creating instances of JsonException with custom details such as message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Sets the detail message of the exception to be built; can accept a String or a Supplier<String> for lazy evaluation.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Sets a description providing further information about the exception; can accept a String or a Supplier<String>.

methods.name: cause
methods.description: Sets the underlying cause Throwable of the exception; can accept a Throwable or a Supplier<Throwable>.

methods.name: href
methods.description: Sets a URI href linking to additional information about the exception; can accept a URI or a Supplier<URI>.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an instance of JsonException with the specified properties.
